title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Some people have told me it is acceptable to go to a religious person's shrine and perform dua to Allah (Like the famous shrine in Ajmer). Keeping the dead person as an intermediary between the person offering dua and Allah. Please mention any quote from Quran which allows or disallows this. 3970 views Q. When I was 20 yrs. old I went to picnic with my college friends, they were went to temple, I also went, they have did darshan/pooja, i have not done the pooja/darshan, as they all were doing, i have also done, I have just put my hand on railing of statue/idol and then put my hand on my chest not with real heart. Then i was really forgoton this, during this period I have made many times tuaba, but I have not mentioned above which i have did in temple in my tauba becasue i have forgot it, and during this period i have recitid many time Kalima, when i becam 25 yrs i was married, but before my marriage Imam Saheb has recited me five Kalima, Imam-e-mujmal and imam-e-mufassal, then my marriage was done and Khutba was done. Before some time I was realized that O Allah I was went in temple and I have done this But not realy heart. 2899 views Q. Assalamualikum.. Ye daroode taj aaya kahase , koi hadith me hai ya phir aaise hi kisi ne banaya hai? kya sahi hai? 10038 views Q. is it true that every human being born in this world will recieve the word of ALLAH...i mean will all the humans including the non muslims come to know abt Islam before they die? i am asking this bcoz one of my non muslim frend died recently aged 15 yrs...i dnt knw wether he died a muslim or not, but i feel he had very less time to understand the meaning of islam and its importance!!!plz reply in detail. 2082 views Q. answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 5515 Country: United Kingdom Title: Salafies claim that deobandhis do not consider whole Quran sharif as a speech of Allah the allmighty. What do they mean that? Please expalin. Question: Salafies claim that deobandhis do not consider whole Quran sharif as a speech of Allah the allmighty. What do they mean that? Please expalin. Answer ID: 5515 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 128/128=M) You should ask its explanation from the salafis that what they mean by this. We people of Deoband ?by the grace of Allah- believe in complete Quran as the words of Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
